about: (Noah) the Tablet of Mysteries' donated weapons (docs/TABLET_OF_MYSTERIES.md): worn = one tier above your class sword, battered = two; uses = hits / arrows / casts before it breaks; lost if you fall. model: the weapon's own (tools/tabletweapons.py; the fists have none - they are gloves, tools/tabletgloves.py); show: the model that rises out of the tablet's pool; gloves: the fists' gloves (first-person and third-person models). (Nov 27: Noah's lineup - seven cut from the pool (kept as forms so old saves load), rarity Rare/Epic/Legendary, rarer rolls less often: 60/30/10.) (Nov 27, build 3: eleven more of his picks - Rare 100 uses, Epic 60, Legendary 30; the throwables by their throws; the Ward-Shield in the left hand, its blocked blows its uses.)

rows.label: Stormtalons
rows.power: Glass claws. Every 3rd hit chains lightning to 2 more of the dead. Heavy: stuns.
rows.owner: Left by a storm-mage who fought with her hands when her magicka ran dry.

rows.label: Gravebell Mace
rows.power: A mace. Every 5th hit tolls the bell, stunning the dead within 5 m.
rows.owner: Taken from a ruined temple of Arkay.

rows.label: Talons of Woe
rows.power: Dragonbone claws. Their bleeding runs twice as deep, and kills heal you a little.
rows.owner: Cut from the talons of a dragon that fell over Whiterun.

rows.label: Riverstone Halberd
rows.power: A halberd. Hits knock the dead back. Heavy: splits the ground in a line ahead.
rows.owner: Dragged out of the White River.

rows.label: Wyrmspine Pike
rows.power: A pike. Thrusts pierce 2 more of the dead in a line. Heavy: a shockwave that staggers the dead within 8 m.
rows.owner: Carved from the spine of the first dragon Alduin raised.

rows.label: Rimewick Quarterstaff
rows.power: A quarterstaff. Light: freezes the dead for 3 s. Heavy: a 10 m blizzard for 6 s.
rows.owner: Carried by a lamplighter of Riften until the lamps went out.

rows.label: Cinderclaws
rows.power: Ember claws. Every swipe sets the dead burning. Heavy: a fan of embers.
rows.owner: Pried from a dremora who walked out of an Oblivion gate.

rows.label: Eclipse Edge
rows.power: A greatsword. Hits alternate frost and sun. Heavy: an ice shockwave, then a sun shockwave (10 m).
rows.owner: Its last bearer saw the sun go out over Sky Haven.

rows.label: The Wandering Star
rows.power: A wand. Hold to cast a gold star every 0.5 s that bounces to up to 4 of the dead. Every 5th hit throws them far.
rows.owner: Found at the bottom of the College's collapsed well.

look.plugin: Fulcimentum - More Staves and Wands of Skyrim.esp

rows.label: Frostmourn Rapier
rows.power: A rapier. Thrusts slow the dead. Heavy: freezes a ring of the dead around you.
rows.owner: Brought from Solstheim by a duellist of Raven Rock.

rows.label: Silver Reaping Scythe
rows.power: A scythe. Every 4th hit: a silver flash that briefly slows the dead.
rows.owner: Left at the Hall of the Vigilant after it burned.

rows.label: Bonereaper
rows.power: A scythe. 1 kill in 4 rises to fight for you for 20 s.
rows.owner: Dug out of a necromancer's grave outside Falkreath.

rows.label: Wyrmtooth Scythe
rows.power: A scythe. Hits make the dead bleed. Heavy: a shockwave that staggers the dead within 8 m.
rows.owner: Pulled from a dragon mound's bones.

rows.label: Bloodmoon Scythe
rows.power: A scythe. Hits drain blood to heal you. Heavy: drains everything it touches.
rows.owner: Taken from a vampire lord who hunted the cursed for sport.

rows.label: Voice of the Mountain
rows.power: A Nordic warhammer. Every hit staggers the dead. Heavy: FUS - a roaring cone that knocks down the dead before you. Every 20 kills it charges FUS RO DAH: the next heavy hurls every one of the dead 12 m ahead off their feet.
rows.owner: Carved with a Word Wall's dragon-script by a Greybeard who came down the mountain once.

rows.label: Soulrender
rows.power: A Daedric mace with a cracked soul gem for a head. Every kill traps a soul (10 fill it). Heavy with a full gem: 3 spectral warriors rise and fight beside you for 12 s.
rows.owner: Its gem was cracked by the last soul it could not hold.

rows.label: Chaurus Fang
rows.power: A Falmer sword dripping chaurus venom. Hits poison the dead. Heavy: a spray of venom in a cone. The poisoned burst into acid when they die, poisoning the ones beside them.
rows.owner: Taken from a Falmer warlord deep under Blackreach.

rows.label: Mace of the Bound
rows.power: Molag Bal's spiked mace. Hits brand the dead violet. Heavy: a slam that brands every one of the dead within 6 m. A branded one that dies bursts into shadowfire.
rows.owner: Molag Bal lends it to anyone who will chain the dead for him.

rows.label: Giant's Toe Club
rows.power: A giant's club. Every hit sends one of the dead flying into the sky. Heavy: a ground stomp that knocks down every one of the dead within 8 m.
rows.owner: A giant left it by his mammoths and never came back for it.

rows.label: Spriggan's Heartroot
rows.power: A mace of spriggan heartwood. Hits heal you a little. Heavy: roots burst from the ground and hold every one of the dead within 6 m for 4 s.
rows.owner: Cut from the heart of a spriggan matron in the Reach.

rows.label: Grasp of Apocrypha
rows.power: A Black Book of Hermaeus Mora. Each cast lashes a tentacle up at the one you aim at; every 5th cast a ring of tentacles drags the dead within 6 m under for 5 s.
rows.owner: Hermaeus Mora wants to know how the Curse ends.

rows.label: Sweetroll of the Damned
rows.power: Thrown: it sings a little Nord tune and every one of the dead nearby runs to it. After 6 s it explodes in a fireball. 5 throws.
rows.owner: Someone always steals it first.

rows.label: Lil' Atronach
rows.power: Thrown: a knee-high Flame Atronach pops out and spins, blasting the dead around it with fire for 10 s. 3 throws.
rows.owner: A conjurer's pet, still warm.

rows.label: Frostbite Egg Sac
rows.power: Thrown: it bursts into webs that hold the dead for 6 s while spiderlings bite them. Webbed ones take double damage. 4 throws.
rows.owner: From a frostbite spider's nest under Riverwood.

rows.label: Dragonguard Ward-Shield
rows.power: A Blades' shield with a ward in its face, worn in your left hand. Blocking: the dead can't hurt you from the front (each blow a use). Power bash: a shield charge that flings the dead in your path.
rows.owner: Carried by the last Dragonguard at Sky Haven Temple.
